item: Half-scratch coefficient openings by default, per-worker reusable scratch, atomic work queue instead of waves (trace decommit)

workload.order: ABBA (A = baseline 87df8e6a5 binary, B = branch binary)

byte_identity.result: all four ABBA runs (both baseline and both branch) hash identically to the reference

conclusion: Byte-identical in all runs. trace_decommit summed stage time drops ~43% (3.23 s -> 1.83 s), reproducible across both B runs and matching the earlier same-binary A/B in the branch commit message (3.10-3.20 -> 1.76-1.82 s). Wall clock fell 1.16 s on average, but the baseline runs themselves spread 4.0% (26.45 vs 27.50 s, under the 5% noise flag but the same order as the effect) and B2 (26.40 s) is level with A1, so the wall gain is not separable from noise in this 4-run sample; per-proof stage seconds also overlap in the pipeline, so the 1.4 s stage saving need not map 1:1 to wall. Realised gain is below the 3-5 s planning estimate. The machine may be shared with other jobs, and prefix4 contains only 3 truth proofs, so the full workload may show a different absolute saving. Peak footprint unchanged.
